user.title: Connect Zepp Life
user.description: Choose a Xiaomi login method for your linked Zepp Life account.

menu_options.browser: Sign in through Xiaomi in your browser

browser.title: Sign in to Xiaomi
browser.description:
[Open Xiaomi sign-in]({login_url}) in your browser, complete any verification, and wait for the Zepp callback page. Copy its full address (or just the code value) into the Authorization field below. The code is short-lived; enter it only in this Home Assistant form.

{error_detail}

data.login_url: Xiaomi sign-in link (copy into a new browser tab)
data.authorization: Zepp callback URL or authorization code
data.member_id: Scale family member ID (-1 = main profile)

password.title: Xiaomi password login
password.description: Use the Xiaomi account paired inside Zepp Life. Google credentials do not work here. Automatic cloud polling starts after setup.\n\n{error_detail}

data.name: Profile name
data.member_id: Scale family member ID (-1 = main profile)

session.title: Xiaomi session login
session.description: Use Xiaomi userId and passToken from your own signed-in Xiaomi browser session or go2rtc Xiaomi login. This is NOT a device token or Zepp apptoken. Enter secrets here only. See README for instructions. Session reuse is experimental and may need reauthentication when Xiaomi expires it.\n\n{error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Xiaomi / Zepp cloud.
error.wrong_account: Sign in to the same Zepp Life account and member as this entry.

init.title: Automatic cloud sync
init.description: Checks for measurements uploaded by the Zepp Life phone app. No Bluetooth receiver is needed at HA.
